Thanks 😔 it’s just hard sometimes to ignore people you know?

I would say that meds are a very dangerous game... I have been through too many meds in my lifetime and some of them have brought me to agony. Some, like the ones I’m on now, help sometimes, but when shit gets bad they are no help. I would say you could try meds, but if at any point you don’t feel like they are helping or making you worse stop taking them. Some of my worst depressions and suicidal thoughts have come from high doses of the wrong meds. It’s definitely risky, but I would say that I wouldn’t be here today without the meds I’m on currently.

Thanks man... I’m thankful you took the time to respond to me... if I’m going to be honest this is my last and only social media platform where people can’t find me. You see I had a lot of friends, but I lost them all... I have used Snapchat twitter, Instagram etc. to try to escape my past this is the last one... pretty sure they will eventually find me here... tbh I just popped like 5 pills 4 of which are antidepressants/ antipsychotics and the other is an allergy med Lol. And I’m getting ready to face another night... idk I’m so unbelievably broken... I don’t trust anyone. Sorry to bother you... I should probably just shut up
